transcript: Good afternoon, welcome to Senaratne and Associates. Let's discuss confidential case details about your property agreement dispute. Good afternoon miss. Mage business partner agreement eka breach karala property eka transfer karanna ra ekak. Eka nisa thamai mama awi. Miss, mama registry eka and contract documents check kara, clause 4 eka anuwa eyata eka karanna widihak na. Mmm, let me check the file. Mahesh, oyage full name eka and NIC eka kiyannako balanna system eke record update karanna. Mage nama Mahesh Gunawardena. NIC eka 1982123456789. Miss? 123, 457. Address eka update karannada? Dan system eke thiyenne 45, Duplication Road, Colombo 3 neda? Na miss, eka parne address eka. Aluth eka number 12, Baseline Road, Borella. මහේෂ් ඔයාගේ phone number එක 077 123 4567 නේද? ඔව්, ඒක තමයි number එක. ND එක එක්මන්ට send කරන්න පුළුවන්ද? මම ඒක කරන්නම්. Saripuriyam, we'll find an injunction order immediately to protect our rights under this. Miss court ekata yanna kali notice eka send karawuda? ඔව්, first formal notice එක send කරමු. මහේෂ්, ඔයාට හෙට office එකට එන්න පුළුවන්ද sign කරන්න? හරි miss, මම හෙට උදේ එන්න. Great. Anita, mama heta udeema draft eka email karannam oya court documentation eka check karala finish karanna.
